name: solera
description: AI-driven project workflow with a mindmap canvas. Three-axis model: Living (Identity, Personas, Journeys, Narratives, Concepts), Time-bound (Milestones, Stories, Action Items), Immutable (Releases). Humans draw; AI decomposes, proposes, and verifies. Ships with skills, MCP server, and four canvases (Service / Plan / Build / Live) over one `.solera/` dotfolder.
